purpose: Held-out accent-diagnostic sentences for evaluating reference clips. Content words must not appear in the ref's transcript — verified by scripts/check_test_overlap.py. Categories cover (a) in-register sentences with lexically disjoint content, (b) out-of-register everyday content with strong British/American distinguishers, (c) phonetic-contrast sentences (BATH-TRAP split, rhotic R, place names, specific vowels).
